title: FPSLocker
description: An overlay that allows users to set custom FPS targets in retail games.
author: masagrator
details:
FPSLocker is an overlay that works with SaltyNX to set custom FPS targets and display refresh rates in Nintendo Switch games.

It supports game-specific patches for titles that need additional modifications to exceed their normal frame rate limits, along with handheld and docked refresh-rate control, display synchronization, buffering options, and automatic config downloads from the FPSLocker Warehouse.

Requires SaltyNX and sys-dock.
